Australian Hightower Highjinx is back! Don't miss out! Join in on the Highjinx!

newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta: Everything You Need to Know
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [h2][b]Welcome to the biggest Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 Beta ever![/b][/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Across two action-packed weekends, experience [i]Modern Warfare® 4's[/i] new Multiplayer modes, a playable Campaign mission, expanded movement systems, Ground War: Combat Outpost, [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™ [/i]Resurgence on the brand-new Zodiac map, and extensive Operator and Loadout customization.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]This article is designed to get you into the action quickly with an overview of every major Beta feature, plus guidance covering the systems, maps, modes, and gameplay mechanics you'll encounter throughout the Beta.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/637cb200ca4187fe790eb621a1755eacac9f995e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]NOTE:[/b] This article showcases the complete [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta experience across both weekends. As the live Beta progresses, additional maps, modes, playlists, and gameplay features become available. Continue playing throughout both weekends to experience everything the Beta has to offer.[/p][p align="start"][b] [/b][/p][p align="start"][b]Let’s begin with the basics. Here’s how to access the Beta:[/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]How to Download and Launch the Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 Beta[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Whether you're joining your first [i]Call of Duty[/i] Beta or returning for another deployment, getting started is straightforward, no matter your platform of choice.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]What do I need to do first?[/h3][p align="start"]Before downloading the Beta, make sure you're ready to play.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Sign in with your Activision Account[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Signing in with your Activision Account allows you to:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Transfer progression across supported platforms, letting you continue with the same profile if you play on more than one platform.[/p][/*][*][p]Keep eligible Beta rewards tied to your Activision ID.[/p][/*][*][p]Access earned Beta rewards when [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches.[/p][/*][*][p]Continue your progression if you switch between supported platforms.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Don't have an Activision Account? [url="https://s.activision.com/cod/signup"][u]Create one here[/u][/url] before launching the Beta to ensure your progression and eligible rewards are saved.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]PC Players:[/b] [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/08/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-next-early-intel-pc-specs"][u]Ensure you’ve read this blog[/u][/url], and optionally[url="https://support.activision.com/articles/trusted-platform-module-and-secure-boot"][u] accessed this article[/u][/url], which sets out TPM2.0/Secure Boot requirements for all PC players.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]When is the Modern Warfare 4 Beta Available?[/h3][p align="start"]The [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta is available during two scheduled Beta weekends.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Early Access (Weekend One)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f51328849d8c2679841a32c79ad8a2f2f71b404c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Early Access begins at [b]11:00 AM PT, Friday August 21[/b] for players on Steam. The Early Access Beta is scheduled to end at [b]10:00 AM PT on Tuesday, August 25.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]Here’s how to participate in the Early Access Beta:[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Redeem a Beta Code, or[/p][/*][*][p]Pre-order or pre-purchase [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]TIP:[/b] If you can't find the Beta, confirm it's currently live for your platform, region, and Beta access window.[/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]How do I redeem a Beta Code?[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]For further information about redeeming a [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta Code, [url="https://support.activision.com/modern-warfare-4/articles/modern-warfare-4-beta-code-support"][u]read our support article here[/u][/url]. Beta Codes are only useful for the Early Access Beta.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Open Beta (Weekend Two)[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4753b4266a4f4dfb7f6a2f9c49bd1c27f7d49b1f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Open Beta begins at [b]10:00 AM PT, Friday August 28[/b] for players on Steam. The Open Beta is scheduled to end at [b]10:00 AM PT on Tuesday, September 1.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]Here’s how to participate in the Open Beta:[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The Beta is available to all players.[/p][/*][*][p]Download the [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta on your platform of choice.[/p][/*][*][p]No pre-order or Beta Codes are needed.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]How do I Download and Launch the Beta?[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta is downloaded separately through your platform's digital storefront. You can preload early before a Beta Weekend begins, or at any time during either Beta Weekend. There are three easy steps:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Preload the Beta.[/p][/*][*][p]Download and install the Beta.[/p][/*][*][p]Launch the game once the Beta is live.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Can I preload the Modern Warfare 4 Early Access or Open Beta?[/i][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Provided you meet the participation criteria for the Early Access Beta (see above), you can preload the Early Access Beta starting at [b]9:00 AM PT on Thursday August 20[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]All players can preload the Open Beta starting at [b]9:00 AM PT on Wednesday August 26[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]How do I download the Modern Warfare 4 Beta on Steam (PC)?[/h3][p][/p][p][i]Download the Beta:[/i][/p][list][*][p]Launch Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Open the Store.[/p][/*][*][p]Search for [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Open the Store page.[/p][/*][*][p]Select “Play Now” next to the Beta.[/p][/*][*][p]Steam automatically adds the Beta to your Library and begins downloading.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]Launch the Beta:[/i][/p][list][*][p]Open your Steam Library.[/p][/*][*][p]Select [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta.[/p][/*][*][p]Click Play.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Frequently Asked Questions about the Modern Warfare 4 Beta[/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]How can I find the Modern Warfare 4 Beta? I can't find it.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Confirm the Beta is currently live.[/p][/*][*][p]Verify your platform has access during the current Beta window.[/p][/*][*][p]Restart your platform's storefront.[/p][/*][*][p]Search again for [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]The Modern Warfare 4 Beta won’t launch. How can I fix this?[/i][/p][list][*][p]Check for available updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Restart your PC.[/p][/*][*][p]Confirm the Beta live window has begun.[/p][/*][*][p]Relaunch the application.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Will my Modern Warfare 4 Beta rewards be available in the full game?[/i][/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Yes. Eligible Beta rewards (detailed below):[/p][list][*][p]Remain tied to your Activision Account.[/p][/*][*][p]Will be available when[i] Modern Warfare 4 [/i]launches on October 23.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]The following Beta progress does not continue after the Beta concludes:[/p][list][*][p]Player level (Rank).[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon unlocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Other in-Beta progression.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][i]Where can I find updated Patch Notes information about the Modern Warfare 4 Beta?[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/07f9045a3dc6a3814608a244e94506de76e5164a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Throughout the Beta, Patch Notes will be updated with the latest gameplay changes, bug fixes, balance adjustments, and other improvements as the team continues to refine the experience. [url="https://www.callofduty.com/patchnotes"][u]Click here to visit the Patch Notes for consistently updated intel[/u][/url].[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4 Beta: Rewards[/h2][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Progress through the Beta, level up, and unlock new cosmetic rewards along the way.[/p][list][*][p]During Weekend One, the first five of the Rewards, up to “Dread Tiger” Operator Skin for Reece, can be unlocked, as the maximum Player Level you can progress to is Level 20.[/p][/*][*][p]During Weekend Two, all eight of the Rewards, up to and including the “Beta Forged” Weapon Blueprint for the Han 86 Assault Rifle, can be unlocked. The maximum Player Level you can progress to is increased to Level 30.[/p][/*][*][p]Earn additional [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Battle Pass Rewards simply for playing the Early Access [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/87553d540b1fcb3728f04e6277e37b77d89780ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p]These rewards will not be available to earn after the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta concludes. All Beta Rewards that you unlock via the game or Twitch Drops (see below) will be available in the full game when it releases on October 23.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f6c142460010825ef0043498d35704318789ae77.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Beta Rewards[/h3][list][*][p][b]Player Level 4:[/b] “Through the Paces” Legendary Emblem[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 8:[/b] “First Served” Weapon Charm[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 12:[/b] “Meonjeo” Legendary Weapon Sticker[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 16:[/b] “Last Charge” Legendary Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 20:[/b] “Dread Tiger” Operator Skin – Reece[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 23:[/b] “Field Tested” Epic Spray[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 26:[/b] “Beta Rights” Epic Loading Screen[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Level 30:[/b] “Beta Forged” Epic Han 86 Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][b] [/b][/p][h3]Additional Rewards: Beta[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]There's even more to unlock throughout the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Beta. There’s a lot to work with in a small area, keeping fights fast and frenetic.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Transit 213[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/990295c75b98a711ed9bbc49fb2986f4ab155fb5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Expect skirmishes throughout an overgrown Indian bus depot where a parking lot of rusting buses divide the battlefield into tight lanes, concealed routes, and close-range ambushes balanced by impressive sightlines across the Center Lot.[/p][p][/p][p][b]TRANSIT 213 TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Unleash the arsenal:[/b] The smaller the map, the easier it is to affect enemies with your Equipment and Field Upgrade. Clear out the open busses with Frag Grenades, obscure your movements with a Smoke Grenade, defend your position with a Trophy System… the more variety you add to your plays, the better your chances of winning the round. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Center Lot dead zone:[/b] Beware the Center Lot busses. They provide cover and concealment against targets on the ground, but their central position makes them easy to rush and often the target of incoming grenades. Always look for enemies inside, and don’t linger too long near the windows. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Quick on the draw:[/b] Speed up your actions with the Fast Hands Perk to reload, use Equipment, and swap weapons faster. On a small map like Transit, it pays to minimize your time spent on these actions so you’re ready to go in the next fight.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][h2]Gunfight (3v3, 10v10, Kill Block)[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3035cf383c4720427652e9208ab867a45d808a5a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW:[/i][/b][i] Gunfight returns on Kill Block, featuring 3v3 and the all-new 10v10 variants.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Single-life rounds featuring randomized shared loadouts.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Kill Block reconfigures every two rounds with a new Combo and Loadout rotation.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Eliminate the opposing team or capture the Overtime Flag to win the round.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Gunfight returns in the [i]Modern Warfare 4 [/i]Beta, bringing its signature single-life elimination gameplay to Kill Block. Fight in either 3v3 or the all-new 10v10 variant as teams battle across ever-changing Kill Block map Combos, with every player using the same randomized Loadout. Victory comes through teamwork, weapon proficiency, and adapting quickly as both the map and your equipment change throughout the match.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a6a3e4766b3f60f95495163ee55ff23fbd8c3f30.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Every two rounds, Kill Block reconfigures into a new Combo — a trio of connected scenic Slabs — while a new randomized Loadout is issued to every player. Teams swap spawn sides between rounds, ensuring both sides compete on the same layout with identical equipment before the next Combo is randomly created. If neither team secures the elimination before time expires, an Overtime Flag appears, forcing one final fight for the round.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/62299e7f942d7c949190d6c8b609e7ed6e1ebba3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]KILL BLOCK GUNFIGHT: TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Squad up:[/b] A lone Operator is an easy target. Push with teammates, trade eliminations, and communicate enemy positions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Master every Loadout.[/b] Every player receives the same randomized weapons, so success comes from adapting quickly rather than relying on a favorite class.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Play both sides.[/b] Teams swap spawn points every round, giving each side an opportunity to attack and defend the same Combo before it changes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Break the stalemate:[/b] Don't forget the Overtime Flag. If neither team is eliminated before time expires, the Overtime Flag becomes the fastest route to victory.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Win the opening fight and use equipment wisely.[/b] Tactical and Lethal Equipment unlock shortly after each round begins. Win the opening engagement with positioning and gunplay before relying on equipment.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3] [/h3][h2]Combat Outpost (24v24, Ground War)[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2934795f76b73954696c7dd2fcd1fe4c265108fd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]NEW Ground War mode for Modern Warfare 4 available across two large-scale maps.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Large-scale objective combat across a sprawling battleground featuring infantry and vehicles.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Captured Outposts become additional spawn locations for your team, expanding your team’s front line.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Unlock escalating team rewards, from Local UAV coverage to armored vehicle support.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Combat Outpost reimagines Domination for Ground War, expanding the familiar three-flag battle into a large-scale conflict across a sprawling battleground. Capture Outposts to earn a steady stream of points while expanding your team's available spawn locations, allowing friendly forces to reinforce the front line and maintain pressure across the map.[/p][p][/p][p]The battle doesn't end once an Outpost is secured. Continue Reinforcing captured positions to unlock increasingly powerful team rewards, from Local UAV coverage and a JLTV airdrop to a Light Tank delivered straight to your Headquarters. With Capture and Reinforce objectives often overlapping, Combat Outpost rewards coordinated teams that can seize territory, defend key positions, and leverage the battlefield advantages they earn.[/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Ground War Multiplayer Maps (24v24, Beta)[/h2][p][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]Battle across two large-scale Combat Outpost battlegrounds set within the Haijin region.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Fight between open countryside and dense urban terrain with infantry and vehicle combat across both maps.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Both maps offer unique routes, landmarks, and tactical opportunities.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Combat Outpost spans two distinct large-scale theaters of conflict, each offering a different approach to Ground War combat. Whether crossing open farmland or fighting through dense urban streets, learning the terrain, major landmarks, and key routes is essential to supporting your team and maintaining control of the match.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][h3]Imjin Farmlands[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/de000d116d85e2d26922844594ee4a2eba040538.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Battle across the rural outskirts of Haijin, where open fields, waterways, scattered farms, and the large-scale mill combine with roads and rail lines to create a combat zone suited to long sightlines, vehicle maneuvering, and coordinated assaults on key strongholds.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]IMJIN FARMLANDS TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Against the grain:[/b] The mill towers over the Imjin Farmlands, making it a prime spot for snipers and Operators looking to get a lay of the land from up high. When approaching from the outskirts, use cover to minimize sightlines onto your position and work with teammates to breach the inner facility from multiple angles. Once inside, switch to close-ranged weapons to speed up combat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Road tax:[/b] The Imjin Farmlands are relatively flat with narrow roads and shortcuts connecting its various sections. When facing enemy vehicles, carry a Launcher into battle and use the even terrain to land hits on target. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Hold for reinforcements:[/b] Don’t just capture and run. In Combat Outpost, victory depends on reinforcing your positions, earning powerful rewards over time including armored vehicles, tanks, and a twin-engine helicopter. Get the goods and then go into battle with the advantage.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3] Wolves Stadium[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd8e10fb8549b36c1115ba8882778d3acd22f6ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight through the heart of Haijin in a dense urban environment centered on the Wolves Stadium. Multi-story buildings, transit lines, tunnels, rooftops, and surrounding hillsides create a highly versatile arena of battle where every route offers multiple ways to advance.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]WOLVES STADIUM TOP TIPS:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Amphitheater ambush:[/b] Ambush foes from the amphitheater stage, protected by a circle of terrain that’s difficult for vehicles to penetrate. Wolves Stadium is full of defensible POIs like this; achieving victory is partly in knowing when to buckle down and defend and when to move on toward the next target.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ascend: [/b]Look for ascenders, ladders, pipes, and anything else that you can use to quickly scale structures. Especially in the thick of downtown, using these shortcuts to obtain a vantage point ASAP will help you lock down critical routes with minimal setup.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Refill for Killstreaks:[/b] Play the long game by sticking near Outposts where you can refill your supplies and fend off attackers from a fortified position. Build up your Killstreaks so that when it’s time to push forward or defend against a large attack, you have the extra support to help turn the battle in your favor.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Call of Duty: Warzone™ Resurgence (44 players, Zodiac Map)[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c53c46a7fec33520fea9b6d89f2692f528e349b5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]QUICK INTEL:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW: [/i][/b][i]Experience Resurgence on the all-new Zodiac map during Weekend Two of the Modern Warfare 4 Beta.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Battle across the DRC Advanced Systems drone assembly headquarters.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Stay alive while your teammates redeploy, then eliminate enemies and complete Contracts to shorten their return timer.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Outlast every opposing squad to secure the win.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1665ed163616d40761d6efa3a75821cfa3a74b04.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Resurgence returns with the all-new Zodiac, a compact combat zone built around the DRC Advanced Systems drone assembly and manufacturing headquarters.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/748b7174fb26a06bab7d0f69e83162660af3ab9a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Fight from the company Admin building through and beneath the central double Trackline with multiple trains, then push toward the R&D facility and shipping docks as squads battle across offices, manufacturing buildings, rooftops, tunnels, and the surrounding shoreline. Expect an explosive tank battle, legendary loot, action across the ground and air, and other surprises to find during your matches.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/26fed4c05111d61c9254db786e3696a8f4fd208d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Every Loadout has room to dominate and are default for the Beta. Choose from AR, SMG, LMG, or Sniper Default Loadouts. Close-range Operators can weave between buildings and through the center of the facility, while longer-range Loadouts benefit from rooftops and elevated windows overlooking the facility’s points of interest. Beneath it all, an underground tunnel network offers another way to rotate, flank enemy squads, or briefly disappear before launching your next attack.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][h3]Development Credits[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 [/i]development is led by Infinity Ward and will be available globally on Steam on Friday, October 23, 2026.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 [/i]for the PC delivers a fully optimized experience, led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, for Steam.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Additional development in alphabetical order: Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Raven Software, Sledgehammer Games, and Treyarch.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]* Actual launch date(s), times, and platform availability of MP Beta subject to change. Online multiplayer subscription may be required for MP Beta.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][p align="start"][i]©/TM/® 2026 Activision Publishing, Inc.[/i][/p][p align="start"][i] [/i][/p][p align="start"][i]For more information, please visit [/i][url="https://www.callofduty.com"]www.callofduty.com[/url][i] and [/i][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/callofduty"][/dynamiclink][i], and follow [u][url="https://twitter.com/activision"]@Activision[/url][/u] and [u][url="https://twitter.com/CallofDuty"]@CallofDuty[/url][/u] and [/i][u][url="https://x.com/InfinityWard"]@InfinityWard[/url][/u][i] on X, Instagram, and Facebook. For Call of Duty Updates, follow [u][url="https://twitter.com/CODUpdates"]@CODUpdates[/url][/u] on X.[/i][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][i]Join [u][url="http://discord.gg/CallofdutyOfficial"]Call of Duty's Official Discord[/url][/u] to get the latest updates and maybe even meet your next squadmate![/i][/p][p][/p]

newsitems.contents: [h3]Call of Duty: NEXT Highlights[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Call of Duty[i]®[/i]: NEXT brought [i][b]Modern Warfare 4[/b][/i][b] Multiplayer[/b] into the spotlight, with live gameplay and new intel on modes, progression, customization, Ground War: Combat Outpost, Kill Block, [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], and more. Here are some of the highlights.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Multiplayer: Boots on the Ground[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] returns to the roots of [i]Modern Warfare[/i] with boots-on-the-ground combat, grounded movement, hard-hitting weaponry, and a balance of speed and responsiveness designed to keep you in the action.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/88f03dca27f5e62542e19385fec3c677f03e4f4c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]NEXT showcased the new [b]Inflation[/b] mode, with [b]Hijack, Arms Deal, and Frontline[/b] also joining the launch lineup. Search and Destroy is confirmed for the Beta.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Hijack (6v6, available during the Beta):[/b] Fight for control of a Data Spike, carrying, throwing, or passing it between teammates as you advance toward the enemy Comm Station. Plant the Spike to score points over time and earn a bonus if it detonates, while defenders counterattack to defuse it before it can score.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Arms Deal (5v5):[/b] Based on Search and Destroy, earn in-match cash through kills and objective play to purchase a limited selection of weapons and equipment each round. It’s single-life and high stakes: get eliminated and you lose your entire loadout.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Frontline (6v6):[/b] Push the line in this team-based respawn mode where players always deploy from their team’s base. Eliminate enemies to score, earning more points for taking them down outside their base, encouraging teams to push forward while defending their own.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Smartstreaks:[/b] Killstreaks now reward both kills and objective play, giving you more ways to contribute toward earning your streaks. Kills remain the primary driver, while playing the objective also counts toward your progress, rewarding a wider range of playstyles.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]The expanded Create-a-Class[/b] brings your Operator, Killstreaks, Perks, weapons, and other choices together within each loadout. Want to get into the fight faster? [b]Gunny[/b] recommends Short Range, Long Range, and Balanced loadouts as starting points, ready to use or customize to suit your playstyle.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][h3]Build Your Arsenal[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/31d4c909b735825e18512bf902df61646a990f30.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The majority of weapons launch with their own [b]Apex Attachment (and occasionally more than one)[/b], offering a unique way to customize how it plays. The new Weapon Progression system cuts down on redundant unlocks, too: unlock an attachment once and build out an arsenal that gives you more options as you move from weapon to weapon.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]Ready to Prestige?[/b] Choose your path. [b]Regular Prestige[/b] returns you to Level 1 while retaining your Create-a-Class unlocks. [b]Classic Prestige[/b] brings the traditional reset experience with additional rewards. Both feature their own rewards and milestones.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]The Weapon Camo journey[/b] also spans [b]Multiplayer, DMZ, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i][/b][i].[/i] Progress each weapon's Camo Track across all three experiences to unlock its Mastery Camo Challenges, with three Mastery Camos to earn in each mode for [b]nine total[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4: Prestige Mastery Camo Showcase[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4: Multiplayer Mastery Camo Showcase[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4: DMZ Mastery Camo Showcase[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Call of Duty: Warzone™ Mastery Camo Showcase[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Ground War: Combat Outpost[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Prepare for the next evolution of Ground War. In [b]Combat Outpost[/b], establish Outposts to earn resources, then put those resources to work completing further objectives. [b]Expect large play spaces combining vehicle and infantry combat with powerful airborne Killstreaks overhead.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Two purpose-built Combat Outpost maps are coming to the Beta, both set within Hajin: [b]Imjin Farmland[/b] and [b]Wolves Stadium[/b], offering distinctly different battlegrounds spanning open terrain, towering structures, and indoor objectives.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]First Deployments into Kill Block[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]With more than 500 combinations, no two [b]Kill Block[/b] deployments play out the same. The living map reconfigures its layout and sightlines from match to match, with weather conditions ranging from clear skies, rain to snow. Look out for Slabs featuring recognizable elements from Modern Warfare favorites including [b]Crash, Highrise, and Shoot House[/b], appearing in randomized placements each match.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4e5c6b8e99ac1bcb8a12c6fa894a15486288bda2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Gunfight[/b] comes to Kill Block in the Beta, but that's just the start. Kill Block is built to support Core modes and Killstreaks, with Search and Destroy and Domination already being put through their paces and additional Core modes and map combinations planned after launch.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Additional Call of Duty: NEXT Intel[/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] launches with [b]12 Core 6v6 maps[/b], spanning locations around the world and built to give each battleground its own distinct identity.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e69a411625591a0163d16eda69e39538629bc555.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]On PC, expect deep control over performance and visual quality across a wide range of hardware, continued focus on mouse responsiveness and visual clarity, shaders prepared ahead of time, and significantly fewer “update requires restart” interruptions — all designed to get you into the action faster.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]And there's more coming to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. [b]Zodiac[/b], built by Beenox, brings a new Resurgence experience with a variety of POIs, familiar features, and one particularly tactical addition: [b]the train[/b]. The DMZ map [b]Hajin[/b] is also coming to Battle Royale, with these two new [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] maps arriving in Season 1.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2]Modern Warfare 4: Multiplayer Vision[/h2][p align="start"][i]Dynamic realism in an elevated battlespace[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]SUMMARY:[/b] Realism, spectacle, and player control balanced to create thrilling, fast-paced and impactful gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] Multiplayer is built around Infinity Ward’s design philosophy: deliver a military combat experience that feels fast, grounded, and cinematic without getting in the player’s way.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]That philosophy carries through the entire experience. Realism shapes how weapons behave, how environments react, and how combat unfolds moment to moment, while fluid movement, unrestricted weapon handling, and cinematic firefights keep every engagement intense, reactive, and under your control. At the same time, the experience amplifies impact, feedback, and the energy of every firefight.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9ad5e7d16a1aec8504dbf2add1aea0807af208e3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The environment reacts dynamically as explosions send debris flying, potted plants shatter, hydrants burst, and nearby explosions shake your footing. But realism isn’t the goal on its own. When it risks adding friction or frustration, Infinity Ward prioritizes control and responsiveness. Movement stays fluid, interactions stay reliable, and the focus remains on the player.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]The result is a Multiplayer experience that delivers grounded realism while remaining exciting, rewarding, and immediately satisfying to play.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]Movement // Overview[/h2][p align="start"][i]Move Freely, Stay in Control[/i][/p][list][*][p]SUMMARY: A refined movement system built around responsiveness, control, and expanded traversal freedom.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Movement in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] is driven by fast and fluid first-person gameplay grounded in believable combat. Every movement mechanic is designed to reduce friction between actions while expanding player freedom across the environment, creating traversal opportunities that feel unrestricted and responsive. Animation transitions have been created to allow players the ability to navigate seamlessly across horizontal and vertical spaces without sacrificing precision or control.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]New traversal and combat movement options are designed to preserve momentum, reward player intent, and expand player choice, supporting a wide range of playstyles, from deliberate tactical positioning to all-out aggression. New movement systems include:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Mantle Slide:[/b] For the first time, you can now transition from a Mantle directly into a Slide to keep the pressure on your enemies. Slide over a car hood, a planter, or low cover and transition instantly into offensive movement.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mantle Momentum:[/b] This preserves forward velocity until the obstacle is cleared. No hard stops, just clean mantles that will help you to pressure targets and keep routes intact.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mantle Steering:[/b] You never lose control while mantling obstacles. You can steer left or right mid-movement, aim down sights (ADS), or even abort the mantle after it starts. This is a system built to keep the game responsive, even in transitional states.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Supine Slide:[/b] Push movement further without sacrificing clarity. Double-tapping crouch during a sprint triggers a longer, lower slide that ends in a supine position (on your back, with feet forward). It opens new tactical possibilities in tight spaces, letting you stay in the fight from unconventional angles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pipe Climb and Fast Pipe Slide:[/b] New pipe traversal mechanics expand vertical movement options across the environment, with the ability to ascend or descend pipework attached to buildings. You can also slide into a vertical pipe while holding crouch, transitioning directly into a fast, controlled descent designed to feel intuitive immediately.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hang Shimmy:[/b] Move left or right while hanging from ledges to reposition before climbing, dropping, or engaging.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hang Lean:[/b] While hanging and aiming down sights, players can lean and rotate their operator with full 360-degree control, allowing for more deliberate positioning and target acquisition while suspended.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Climbing Jump:[/b] Jump precisely in any direction while hanging, climbing ladders, or traversing pipes, expanding routes and allowing faster repositioning across the environment.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Let’s explore some of this in more detail:[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3]Movement // Mantling Control[/h3][p align="start"][i]Mantle Control and Choices[/i][/p][list][*][p]SUMMARY: Mantling now allows early player control, unlocking advance, attack, or retreat options during the transition.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Mantling has been rebuilt to give players greater control during movement transitions. Instead of being locked into an animation, players can steer mid-mantle, Aim Down Sights while entering a space, sprint out to preserve momentum, or disengage entirely to reposition and reassess.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Mantling is now a choice, not a commitment.[/p][h3] [/h3][h3]Movement // Fluidity as You Traverse[/h3][p align="start"][i]Chaining Movement, Preserving Momentum[/i][/p][list][*][p]SUMMARY: Movement actions connect seamlessly, preserving momentum while adapting dynamically to player state and environmental traversal.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Instead of interrupting the flow, actions like sprinting, sliding, mantling, climbing, and transitioning to prone can all be chained together to maintain control across a map, creating seamless paths through contested spaces.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Movement systems also adjust dynamically to player speed and state. Sprint landings adapt depending on height and momentum, mantling while sprinting preserves forward movement, and players can transition into low-profile movement to continue navigating under cover or fighting from unconventional angles.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Expect the full suite of movement mechanics to be available across Campaign, Multiplayer, DMZ, and [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Warzone[/i]™.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Master this flow of movement actions to elevate your effectiveness at [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]. At launch, players can test those skills in a dedicated movement training course built around speed, movement chaining, and route mastery.[/p][p][/p][h2] [/h2][h2]Gunplay[/h2][p align="start"][i]Every shot matters[/i][/p][list][*][p]SUMMARY: A refined weapons system delivering consistent and responsive gunplay where outcomes are determined by player execution.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7b3949021f1ee85c589585d93b298a7ab926b599.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Modern Warfare 4’s[/i] gunplay is built around a balance between grounded realism and intuitive gameplay, combining precision aiming, physical weapon handling, enhanced visibility, and refined audio design. Bullet trajectory, weapon motion, operator stance, camera behavior, audio, FOV, and target visibility all align within a highly tuned combat fidelity system.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Many of these refinements work beneath the surface, improving how weapons look, sound, move, and respond while keeping firefights readable and intuitive, even during aggressive movement and sustained firefights. Handling, recoil, and sight clarity have all been refined for greater consistency and control, reinforcing precise gunplay where player execution determines the outcome.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]The goal is simple: no bloom, no guesswork, no doubt. newsitems.title: The International Main Event
newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/a7ab9b6d4c788583a689e0519021a93a76c17f30.png"][/img][/p][p]The sixteen best Dota teams in the world spent the last week battling through an intense Group Stage, and now only eight contenders remain. In a matter of hours Team Vision, Team Liquid, Nigma Galaxy, Team Falcons, BoomBoys, Team Spirit, Iron Wing, and Team Yandex will begin the final push to claim the Aegis of Champions as they all fight to be the last team standing at The International 2026.[/p][p]The double elimination bracket that will crown our champions kicks off at SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center in Shanghai on Thursday, August 20 and will culminate in a best-of-five Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23. We congratulate everyone who has made it this far, and we eagerly await the final test.[/p][p][/p][h2]Attending The International[/h2][p]If you're heading to the arena in Shanghai to watch The International live, a flurry of activity awaits you. Check out some of the more important details below.[/p][p][/p][h3]Schedule [/h3][p]The International pre-show begins each day at 9:30 AM China Standard Time. Things officially kick off with the Opening Ceremony at 10 AM on Thursday, and the first series is scheduled to start soon after. On the following days, matches will begin at 10 AM. Take in the [url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]full schedule of matches available here[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]Meet the Teams[/h3][p]Each day of the Main Event, fans will have the chance to attend meet and greets with teams and talent on the 2F Concourse of the arena. Fan participation will be determined by a random draw of eligible ticket holders who have purchased tickets prior to 5 PM the day before. Selected fans will be notified electronically — as well as on TV displays throughout the venue concourse. More information on slots and eligibility will be provided on site.[/p][p][/p][h3]Crimson Witness and Badge Binding[/h3][p]Attendees should pick up their commemorative badges and event swag bags when they scan a digital ticket for their first entry into the venue. Remember to bind your badge to your Steam account to ensure you're eligible for Crimson Witness Treasure drops on the First Blood of each game at The International.[/p][p][/p][h3]Venue Information[/h3][p]To help things run smoothly, here's a rundown of some venue details you should know:[/p][list][*][p][b]What time do doors open? [/b]Arena doors open every day at 8 AM China Standard Time, two hours before the first match. Please note that entry will not be allowed after 9 PM each evening.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Where should I enter the arena?[/b] [url="https://cdn.steamstatic.com/apps/dota2/images/dota_react//international2026/map.png"]Please queue for entrance at the arena's Gate 0 Plaza[/url]. Those with 1F Stands and Suites tickets, please queue at the left-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. Those with 3F Stands tickets, please queue at the right-side (facing the venue) security checkpoint. After passing through the turnstile for ticket verification, please collect your swag bag.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Can I sit anywhere or are there preassigned seats?[/b] Seats at The International 2026 are assigned. Please make sure to queue in the entry area designated outside of the arena for your seating sections.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Is re-entry permitted?[/b] All ticket holders are permitted to enter and exit the venue up to THREE times per match day. For re-entry, please re-queue in the designated lane.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The On-Site Secret Shop[/h3][p]The Secret Shop will operate in SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center from August 20 - 23, opening each day at 9:00am and closing after the first break of the last series of the day. Customers are welcome to purchase directly from on-site cashiers or use the Perfect World app to place an order for pick-up.[/p][p][/p][h3]On-Site Activities[/h3][p]In addition to SecretLab and SteelSeries booths in the concourse, The International Players Jackets and Championship rings from all previous years will be on display. Plus, all fans are invited to leave their mark on the event by signing one of the graffiti walls. There will also be opportunities to take photos with cosplayers roaming the arena on Saturday and Sunday, and don't forget to check out the handmade embroidered Aegis of Champions on display throughout the event.[/p][p][/p][h3]Cosplay Finalists[/h3][p]Don't miss the best of this year's crop of Dota 2 cosplay, on display in the arena on August 23 before the Grand Finals.[/p][p][/p][h3]Watching The International Online[/h3][p]Even if you can't make it to the arena, there are still a ton of options to catch all the action at The International. newsitems.title: The International: Streams, Secret Shop, and More

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/aa83bcaaafe7cd4d11a841ec381ec28ccb039d41.png"][/img]It's the final countdown: Players and talent have landed, and all of the pieces are falling into place to make Shanghai the center of the Dota universe for the next two weeks. It's time to finish crafting your fantasy rosters, lock in your first round of predictions, and get ready to tune in because The International 2026 is almost underway.[/p][p]Whether you're looking to watch online, find Dota activities in Shanghai to keep you busy until streams start, or looking for merch you can wear while you're out in Shanghai waiting for games to start, we've got you covered below.[/p][p][/p][h3]The International Group Stage[/h3][p]Sixteen teams have earned the right to compete for the Aegis of Champions in Shanghai, but only eight will face off in the main event. First, they must survive the gauntlet of the Swiss Format Group Stage.[/p][p][url="https://www.dota2.com/esports/ti15/schedule"]Group Stage games begin[/url] on Thursday, August 13 and wrap on Sunday, August 16. In that span, all sixteen teams will play best-of-three matches against other teams with the same overall series record. A fourth series win will earn a team an automatic berth at The International; a fourth loss will result in elimination.[/p][p]By end of play on Saturday, three teams will have secured spots in The International and three teams will have been eliminated. The ten remaining teams will face off in a special elimination round to decide the rest. Every single one of the five series on Sunday will send one team home and the other onward to the main event.[/p][p][/p][h3]The International Main Event[/h3][p]On Thursday, August 20, The International will move to SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center and open the doors to more than ten thousand fans. Four days of intense play through a double-elimination bracket will culminate in the Grand Finals on Sunday, August 23, and only then will the last team stand victorious and raise the Aegis of Champions.[/p][p]Tickets for the event are sold out, but there are tons of ways to watch online — and even a handful of special in-person opportunities available around the city of Shanghai.[/p][p][/p][h3]Tournament Streams[/h3][p]There's nothing quite like watching the best Dota players in the world face off in a live event, and while life and accompanying biological imperatives can make it difficult to try and watch every single game live, here are all the links you'd need to make a glorious attempt.[/p][p][/p][p]Chinese: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_cn_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]English: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Russian: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_RU"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_ru_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Spanish: Twitch: [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es"]Stream A[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_2"]Stream B[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_3"]Stream C[/url], [url="https://www.twitch.tv/dota2ti_es_4"]Stream D[/url]; Steam: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Dota/sale/TheInternational2026"]All Streams[/url]; YouTube: [url="https://www.youtube.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url]; Facebook: [url="https://www.facebook.com/dota2"]All Streams[/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Dota 2 Heroes Around Shanghai[/h3][p]From August 13 to August 18, multiple Dota heroes will descend upon iconic landmarks across Shanghai, with a giant Aegis of Champions making its grand debut. Meanwhile, several commercial districts have set up check-in spots for fans to visit and collect souvenirs.[/p][p]Check out the landmark details below or visit [url="https://act.dota2.com.cn/2026/shanghaitour"]Perfect World's Shanghai Dota Tour site[/url] for a handy map.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Dota Hero Landmark Locations[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Wujiaochang Commercial District[/p][/*][*][p]Wujiaochang Guangchang: Aegis of Champions[/p][/*][*][p]Bailian ZX Fun Mall: Queen of Pain, Axe, and Pudge[/p][/*][*][p]Shanghai Wujiaochang Wanda Plaza: Juggernaut[/p][/*][*][p]Lujiazui Super Brand Mall (Aug 12-18): Windranger[/p][/*][*][p]Shanghai EXPO Culture Park (Aug 13-18): Mars and Shadow Fiend[/p][/*][*][p]Taikoo Li Qiantan (Aug 18–24): Aegis of Champions, Drow Ranger, Crystal Maiden, and Juggernaut[/p][/*][*][p]Standard Check-in Spots: Lujiazui 96 Plaza, New bund 31, Shanghai No. 1 Shopping Center, Expo Place[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]The Secret Shops[/h3][p]If you're looking to scope out this year's merchandise offerings, our partner stores are already online for both Chinese and international customers.[/p][list][*][p]For China domestic fans: [url="https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/"]https://wmsjdj.tmall.com/[/url] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]For fans everywhere else: [url="https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/"]https://pwrdesports.aliexpress.com/[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]The Secret Shop will also operate in SPD Bank Oriental Sports Center from August 20 - 23, opening each day at 9:00am and closing after the first break of the last match series of the day. Customers are welcome to purchase directly from onsite cashiers or use the Perfect World app to place an order for pick-up.[/p][p][/p][h3]Community Streams[/h3][p]The strength of Dota has always been its vibrant and passionate community. The International is an expression of that, both the in-person event and the many millions who participate online, those watching and those streaming.[/p][p]Speaking of which: As always, we welcome community streams of the event. There's more detail in [url="https://www.dota2.com/dotatv"]the community stream FAQ[/url], but to summarize: You have a lot of freedom in how to stream your TI commentary the way you and your viewers want as long as your stream is based on DotaTV and your own content, not on someone else's stream (including ours).[/p][p][/p][h3]Wrapping Up[/h3][p]There's obviously a lot going on already, but there's even more info about The International to come. We'll be back soon to provide more details about on-site events, badges, Crimson Witness drops and more as we move closer to the show. Until then, make sure to get those predictions in. We'll see you when groups start.[/p]

newsitems.title: The International: Predictions, Fantasy, and Supporter Bundles
newsitems.author: kyled
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/5c825b3d35627bfc4276c013745aa6fd4de935ea.png[/img]

Nearly a year has passed since Team Falcons hoisted the Aegis of Champions as the final team standing in Hamburg. But that was last year's story, and the time has come to turn our thoughts to Shanghai and the crop of competitors who vie to write the tale of [i]this[/i] year. All of their battles have brought them to the precipice. The International is just two weeks away.

After a decisive month of intense qualifiers, dominant performances from prior champions, and upset victories from up-and-comers, all sixteen teams have earned their invitations to this year's International.

Now it's time for us to extend an invitation to you.

We've just released an update featuring this year's TI-themed activities and item bundles. Not sure what that means? Keep reading for a handy guide to all the different ways to participate so you can find the content that's most interesting to you.

[list][*][b]I want to directly support my favorite teams and personalities.[/b][/list]
With supporter bundles for all sixteen teams and more than a hundred participating event talent, there's never been a better time to support your favorites. In addition to the four primary event languages, this year we're also offering community bundles for WXC Co. (Filipino), NS_ART (Brazilian Portuguese), and Maincast (Ukrainian). 50% of sales from supporter bundles (teams, talent, and community broadcasts) goes directly to the team or talent and 30% goes to the tournament prize pool.

[list][*][b]I want to show off that I supported my favorite team.[/b][/list]
Purchasing team supporter bundles of various levels will grant all kinds of things: custom sprays, a special badge for your health bar, custom team emoticons, custom chat wheel lines, and — new this year as a part of the Gold tier — a global effigy. This new building will replace your regular effigy through the end of September, allowing you to show your team support right in your base. Not supportive enough? You can purchase additional supporter levels that will upgrade the appearance of your effigy, including custom effects.

[list][*][b]I'm right about everything. Help me prove it.[/b][/list]
Predictions are back: How will the Swiss matches shake out? What about the bracket? Fun fact: Exactly zero have ever gotten the full Swiss stage results correct. Will you be the first this year? Not if you don't get your guesses in before the first match starts (10am CST, Thursday 8/13).

[list][*][b]I'm a huge fan of my favorite team but also I dislike all of their choices and wish I was in charge.[/b][/list]
We've got a new take on fantasy this year. We've introduced a new customization point: You. You're the coach, and can now assign custom modifiers to yourself that influence your whole team. We've also updated prefixes, suffixes, and the player drafting rules. You'll draft your perfect team in (mostly) pairs: both supports from one team, the safelaner and offlaner from one team, and then your favorite midlaner. 

[list][*][b]I am a Dota player and I'm already assuming I'll be the best at everything. What do I win?[/b][/list]
Like last year, awards will be granted to participating players based on their performance relative to everyone else. The Tyrian Regalia treasure is making a royal return with five refashioned Immortal items, exclusively available to the top performing players. New this year is the Terrain Token, which will allow winners to choose one of six returning custom terrains, including Reef's Edge and Immortal Gardens. Look for more information, including reward tiers and lots of details, in the Rewards section of the main Dota 2 menu.

[list][*][b]All of this is great but I did my predictions and my fantasy and supported the teams and talent already. What do I do [i]now[/i]?[/b][/list]
Good news for you: We also just shipped a new gameplay patch along with a ton of content fixes. Check out the [url=https://dota2.com/summerscrub2026]Summer Scrub 2026[/url] page for more details.
